evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Conversational context resolves identity, ownership, and durable user facts into a structured visual memory.
During operation, VisualMem applies LLM-mediated memory editing to personal image evidence; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Cross-turn evidence is reconciled to resolve identity, ownership, and persistent user facts. For VisualMem, this specifically supports evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence of personal image evidence.
During operation, VisualMem applies LLM-based resolution of conflicting records to personal image evidence; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, VisualMem applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to personal image evidence; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (personal image evidence) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence, LLM-based resolution of conflicting records, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
